Coverage_Description: Worldwide hospital and surgical cover (HS1/HS2/HS3) including clinic surgery, plus optional outpatient (GP/specialist/physio/chinese medicine; 100% or 80% reimbursement; 30 visits/year), optional in-patient top-up (80% excess over Hospital & Surgical items 1-9
pricing: Annual premium per member (HK$): Hospital & Surgical HS1 3,531; HS2 1,755
customer requirement: Hong Kong operating company; minimum 5 employees (2-4 employees only HS3 + OP4 and must enroll both Hospital & Surgical and Optional Clinical)
price structure: Annual per-member tiered premium by plan level; optional benefits priced as add-ons
additional informations: pre-existing/signs within 3 months before coverage start are excluded unless continuously insured under same Prudential group medical policy; HIV/AIDS-related treatment excluded during first 5 membership years
